Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

tidylayouts (development version)

  • New layout engine built on ggplot2 and grid; no longer depends on ggalign. Plots are aligned by their panel edges, also across nested rows and columns.
  • row(), column() and grid() gain horizontal_align and vertical_align (defaults "left" and "bottom"). They place the container’s direct plots; nested rows, columns and grids fill their space and use their own alignment. grid() shares row and column tracks.
  • New layout_plots() builds a layout from a design string, e.g. "ABEF\nCDEF\nGGGG". Letters place the plots; by default each design line becomes a row (arrange_by = "row"), alternatively a column or a grid. Tags are numbered in reading order, and tag_group() works on its inputs. Plots keep their sizes; stretch_x, stretch_y, center_x and center_y change that for listed plots.
  • add_right() and add_below() append to a row or column of the same direction and wrap everything else.
  • New stretch_x() and stretch_y() let a plot’s panel stretch into the spare space next to it; center_x() and center_y() keep the panel size and center the plot in that space. Panel sizes are set on the plot with tidyplots::adjust_size() or theme(panel.widths, panel.heights).
  • New tag_group() lets several plots share one panel tag.
  • New save_layout() saves a figure at its exact physical size.
  • layout_tags() aligns tags at the top of each row; layout_size() sets the figure size in mm.
  • spacer() without a size now absorbs leftover space.
  • Plot backgrounds are drawn before all plots, so axis labels sticking out past a plot are no longer covered by the neighbouring plot’s background.
  • layout_spacing(inner, outer) now sets the gaps between plots in mm (one value, or c(horizontal, vertical)), replacing the plots’ own margins, plus an optional outer margin around the figure.
  • Removed layout_alignment(); use horizontal_align and vertical_align.

Developed by Jan Broder Engler.
